negativeProbes.conclusion: the adapter is a necessary structural check and is not sufficient. Four classes escape it here: a success count at or above the floor, the window size, the replacement-before-primary ordering, and spentness. All four are held in this record and were derived or fixed independently
negativeProbes.whatChangedSinceWindow01: at Window 01's TEN-entry ledger the adapter's P6 first arm was false at ANY success count, so no forged count was detectable. At fifteen entries the first arm is true, so a forged count BELOW 50 is now caught. A forged count at or above 50 still is not. The gap narrowed; it did not close
